The Challenge

Although the challenge originates from The Red Pill, this challenge is in no way associated to it. This subverse, and the N3 challenge especially are about providing a slightly competitive challenge, along with some accountability, all focused on long term, sustainable self improvement. You'll notice that much of the below is copied from the original challenge. Ultimately, the #N3 challenge is to:

1) Give up Three Vices for a month.

2) Take up One Daily activity for a month.

We want you to choose three vices you want to ditch for the month (and maybe for longer!) Some chose porn, some chose alcohol, and some chose voat (bastards). Pick three vices or distractions that you want to remove from your life and kick them to the curb. If you pick alcohol or cigarettes, get them out of your house. If you pick porn, install that parental control software.

Now for the new part of N3, making sure that no day is wasted, we say no to nothing. Pick an activity or chore that you want to make sure gets done daily. It can be big, or it can be small. Clean your apartment, make your bed, hit the gym, approach at least 3 women a day, shave, work on your hobby project at least an hour a day. Whatever it is, it's time to pick it and make a real schedule to include it in your day.

Sit down with your calendar and figure out what time of the day you'll need to dedicate to your NoNothingSomething. Figure out Thanksgiving. If you are ditching alcohol or taking up the gym, there's no excuse for Thanksgiving. You must commit.

Track your progress

  • Track on your personal blog, or

  • Twitter, use hashtag #nonothingnovember or

  • Use this subverse to post your progress: /v/21days

Start tracking your progress by announcing your goals. If you make a new post in /v/21days you can use that thread to post updates as you go. If you use twitter, sticky your goals at the top of your page. Discuss how you plan to achieve these goals and what steps you're going to take to ensure that they happen.

Contest

Last year we made it a contest, but the format of this challenge doesn't really lend itself to contest modes, so this year we're doing it a little different. Every day that you update your progress, update how many days you have completed the challenge. Yes, this requires the honor system. If you're using /v/21days, you can edit your post to show your progress at the top of your post.

At the end of the month, people who have met their goals should contact the moderators.
